🚘 VALPOI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL, GOA – RECRUITMENT 2026

An opportunity to work with Valpoi Municipal Council!

Applications are invited for 1 Driver post on a regular basis.

📌 Post: Driver 
📍 Location: Valpoi, Goa 
🎓 **Qualification: SSC (10th Pass) 
💼 **Experience: Minimum 2 years in the relevant field 
🪪 Requirement: Valid Heavy Vehicle Driving Licence 
🗣️ Languages: English and Konkani (Marathi desirable) 
💰 Pay Level: Pay Matrix Level 2 
📋 Category: Unreserved

How to Apply?

Eligible candidates must submit their applications offline at the Office of Valpoi Municipal Council, Valpoi, Goa, along with the required supporting documents.

📅 Last Date to Apply: 1st December 2026

Interested and eligible candidates are advised to read the complete recruitment details and ensure that all required documents are attached before submitting their applications.
